svg.title: G3 validation: predicted against observed
svg.desc: One panel per configuration: each dot is a validation request-cell, predicted latency against observed latency on log axes, with the identity line and a plus or minus 30 percent band.
svg.text: G3 validation (V01-V05): r2_component predicted against observed latency
Each dot is one request-cell (630 per configuration). Diagonal: perfect prediction; dashed: ±30%.
